title: Welfare
subtitle: 本課限定語境：welfare = the health, safety, comfort, and general well-being of a person or animal
description: 本課限定語境：welfare = the health, safety, comfort, and general well-being of a person or animal, especially when someone has responsibility for protecting or caring for them · 「福祉；福利；安康；照顧與保障」

words.note: 表示一個人或動物整體的身體、心理和生活狀況。
words.example: The school places a strong emphasis on students' well-being.
words.exampleZh: 學校非常重視學生的身心福祉。

exercises.original: The school introduced new counselling services to improve student welfare.
exercises.zh: 學校推出新的輔導服務，以改善學生的身心福祉。
exercises.upgrade: The school introduced new counselling services to improve student well-being.

options.explanation: 輔導可能有保護作用，但句子更廣泛地涉及學生心理和情緒狀況。
counselling services 最直接支持 mental/emotional well-being，因此這是最自然替代。
表示紀律管理，不等於福祉。
是出席率。
是學業／表現成果。
是監督，不代表整體身心狀況。

exercises.original: Long working hours can damage employees' welfare.
exercises.upgrade: Long working hours can damage employees' well-being.

options.explanation: 工作士氣會受影響，但只涵蓋心理／團隊情緒的一部分。
long working hours can affect physical, mental and emotional health, making well-being the broadest fit.
薪酬未必因工時長而「受損」。
可能下降，但那是工作結果，不是員工福祉。
無關。
也不是整體健康狀況。

exercises.original: The organization monitors the welfare of staff working in high-stress environments.
exercises.upgrade: The organization monitors the well-being of staff working in high-stress environments.

options.explanation: high-stress environments suggests concern for employees' mental and physical condition.
the organization may also monitor performance, but this does not mean welfare.
only concerns timeliness.
are credentials, not condition.
may affect welfare but is not welfare itself.
career progression is different.

words.note: 表示對人或動物以避免殘酷、不必要痛苦和虐待的方式對待。
words.example: The rules are designed to ensure the humane treatment of animals.
words.exampleZh: 這些規則旨在確保動物受到仁道對待。

exercises.original: The new regulations are intended to improve the welfare of animals during transport.
exercises.zh: 新規例旨在改善動物在運輸期間所受到的仁道待遇。
exercises.upgrade: The new regulations are intended to improve the humane treatment of animals during transport.

options.explanation: animals during transport + regulations points to how they are handled and whether suffering is minimized.
是生產效率，不是待遇。
速度只是運輸操作的一部分；仁道待遇更廣。
是經濟價值。
是繁殖數據。
是所有權。

exercises.original: Inspectors checked whether the shelter met acceptable animal welfare standards.
exercises.upgrade: Inspectors checked whether the shelter met acceptable standards of humane treatment.

options.explanation: acceptable ... standards in an animal shelter strongly refers to ethical, non-cruel treatment.
是其中一項管理細節，但不能涵蓋整體待遇。
是成本問題。
是營運結果。
可能影響照顧品質，但不是待遇本身。
無法代表 animal welfare standards。

exercises.original: The organization campaigns for better welfare for working animals.
exercises.upgrade: The organization campaigns for more humane treatment of working animals.

options.explanation: working animals + campaigning for better welfare emphasizes reducing cruelty and improving treatment.
describes how animals are used, not whether treatment is humane.
not the central ethical issue.
could affect welfare, but is only one factor.
administrative issue.
commercial issue, not overall treatment.

words.note: 表示實際照料某人的健康、安全和日常需要。
words.example: Older residents need access to appropriate care and support.
words.exampleZh: 年長居民需要適當的照顧與支援。

exercises.original: The charity provides welfare for older people who live alone.
exercises.zh: 慈善機構為獨居長者提供照顧。
exercises.upgrade: The charity provides care for older people who live alone.

options.explanation: provides ... for older people is a service-delivery context, so care is more natural than the abstract welfare.
may be one aspect of care, but too narrow.
financial support is different.
may improve quality of life, but is not care itself.
unrelated.
not the intended support.

exercises.original: Good welfare for children includes proper nutrition, medical support, and emotional attention.
exercises.upgrade: Good care for children includes proper nutrition, medical support, and emotional attention.

options.explanation: important, but nutrition and emotional attention go beyond protection from harm.
all three examples—nutrition, medical support and emotional attention—are concrete dimensions of care.
too narrow and misses health/emotional support.
not the main concept.
is evaluation, not support.
one possible need, but not the umbrella term.

exercises.original: The rescue centre is responsible for the welfare of injured animals until they recover.
exercises.upgrade: The rescue centre is responsible for the care of injured animals until they recover.

options.explanation: injured animals + until they recover directly points to feeding, treatment and day-to-day care.
not appropriate for injured animals' recovery.
legal status, not welfare service.
may be needed, but only one logistical function.
administrative categorization.
may happen later but is not recovery care.

words.note: 表示防止某人或動物受到傷害、虐待、危險或剝削。
words.example: The law provides greater protection for vulnerable children.
words.exampleZh: 法律為弱勢兒童提供更大保障。

exercises.original: The law was strengthened to improve the welfare of children at risk of abuse.
exercises.zh: 法律得到加強，以改善有受虐風險兒童的保障。
exercises.upgrade: The law was strengthened to improve the protection of children at risk of abuse.

options.explanation: care is important, but the legal context and abuse risk specifically point to protection from harm.
law + at risk of abuse makes prevention of harm the decisive meaning.
not the main legal goal here.
unrelated to abuse prevention.
may identify risk, but does not itself protect.
school attendance is not the core issue.

exercises.original: Animal welfare laws prohibit unnecessary cruelty and neglect.
exercises.upgrade: Animal protection laws prohibit unnecessary cruelty and neglect.

options.explanation: laws against cruelty and neglect are specifically designed to protect animals from harm.
not an ethical/legal concept here.
only one possible regulated activity.
ownership law can overlap but is not the same.
too narrow.
also too narrow.

exercises.original: The agency is responsible for child welfare in cases involving serious neglect.
exercises.upgrade: The agency is responsible for child protection in cases involving serious neglect.

options.explanation: important for children but not the immediate issue in neglect cases.
serious neglect indicates safeguarding children from harm, making child protection the standard term.
can be one intervention but not the agency's whole responsibility.
may sometimes be relevant but is not the umbrella concept.
not central.
assessment can support protection but is not protection itself.

words.note: 表示一個人的健康、舒適、獨立、尊嚴和日常生活滿意程度。
words.example: The treatment improved the patient's quality of life.
words.exampleZh: 治療改善了病人的生活質素。

exercises.original: The new treatment improved the patient's welfare even though it did not cure the disease.
exercises.zh: 新療法雖然沒有治癒疾病，但改善了病人的生活質素。
exercises.upgrade: The new treatment improved the patient's quality of life even though it did not cure the disease.

options.explanation: can improve independently, but the sentence specifically contrasts symptom/life improvement with no cure.
This phrase is standard when treatment improves comfort, function or daily living without curing the disease.
the diagnosis does not improve.
only one treatment detail.
administrative documentation.
future outlook may improve, but quality of life is the direct lived-experience concept.

exercises.original: Better housing can improve the welfare of older residents.
exercises.upgrade: Better housing can improve the quality of life of older residents.

options.explanation: better housing can improve comfort, independence, safety and daily experience, all core components of quality of life.
may or may not change; it is a different measure.
housing quality does not automatically increase income.
not the focus for older residents.
a specific service, not the overall outcome.
unrelated.

exercises.original: Access to parks, healthcare, and safe streets all contribute to community welfare.
exercises.upgrade: Access to parks, healthcare, and safe streets all contribute to community quality of life.

options.explanation: parks, healthcare and safety jointly affect residents' everyday living conditions and well-being.
these factors do not simply determine how many people live there.
may be related indirectly but is not the welfare outcome.
too narrow.
one dimension only.
also one social indicator, not the whole concept.

falseSynonyms.zh: 財富 ≠ welfare wealth 是金錢和資產；welfare 是福祉。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A person can be wealthy but still have poor physical or emotional well-being.

falseSynonyms.zh: 快樂 ≠ 整體福祉 happiness 只是情緒層面；welfare 還包括健康、安全、照顧和生活條件。
好處／福利 ≠ welfare 的所有意思 benefit 可指某項好處或補助，但 welfare 是更廣的整體福祉概念。
安全 ≠ 全部 welfare safety 是 welfare 的一部分，但沒有涵蓋健康、舒適、心理狀況等。
照顧 ≠ 福祉結果 care 是提供幫助的行為／服務；welfare 是被照顧者整體狀況。
福利金／社會福利 ≠ 本課 welfare 義項 welfare benefits 屬政府經濟支援義項，和本課「福祉、安康」不同。
- well = 健康地／良好的 - well-being = 福祉、安康
- humane = 仁慈、人道的 - human = 人類的 不能混淆： human treatment ✗（通常不是「仁道待遇」的意思）
